# TestMu AI

> > TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest) is a comprehensive testing platform offering AI-powered testing with KaneAI, cross-browser testing, mobile app testing, and test automation across 3000+ real devices and browsers.

The platform provides live testing, Selenium and Appium automation, and integrations with popular project management tools. TestMu AI serves developers and QA teams with tutorials, documentation, and tools for web and mobile testing across multiple frameworks including Python, JavaScript, and Flutter.

## Key Topics

- KaneAI - Generative AI testing agent
- Selenium WebDriver automation
- Appium mobile testing
- Cross-browser compatibility testing
- iOS testing and simulators
- Python test automation
- Agile software development
- Responsive web design
- CSS animations and effects
- Browser compatibility
- Mobile app testing (XCUITest, Espresso)
- Bug tracking integrations
- WebdriverIO framework
- Pytest parameterization
- Flutter app automation

## Core Testing Platform

- [KaneAI – World's First Generative AI Testing Tool](https://www.testmuai.com/generative-ai-testing-tool): KaneAI generative AI testing agent with natural language test authoring
- [Live Testing On TestMu AI | Web Testing and App Testing](https://www.testmuai.com/live-testing): Live cross-browser and app testing on 3000+ real devices and emulators
- [Online Browser Compatibility Testing on iPhone 16 Pro](https://www.testmuai.com/test-on-iPhone-16-pro-mobile-browser-online): iPhone 16 Pro browser compatibility testing with real devices and Appium
- [iOS Simulators for Linux](https://www.testmuai.com/ios-simulator-for-linux): iOS simulators for Linux with Appium automation and parallel testing

## Selenium Automation Tutorials

- [Use Selenium wait for page to load with Python [Tutorial]](https://www.testmuai.com/blog/selenium-wait-for-page-to-load): Selenium WebDriver wait strategies tutorial for Python automation

- [Selenium with Python Tutorial: Adding Extensions in Firefox for Testing](https://www.testmuai.com/blog/adding-firefox-extensions-with-selenium-in-python): Selenium Python tutorial for adding Firefox extensions using WebDriver API
- [How To Do Parameterization In Pytest With Selenium?](https://www.testmuai.com/blog/parameterization-in-pytest-with-selenium): Pytest parameterization with Selenium using fixtures and decorators
- [WebdriverIO Tutorial: Browser Commands for Selenium Testing](https://www.testmuai.com/blog/webdriverio-tutorial-browser-commands-for-selenium-testing): WebdriverIO browser commands tutorial for Selenium test automation
